The '''Major Forbidden Archive''' is a [[Point of Interest]] located in {{Location|Nimbus Sanctum}}. It's only unlocked after completing {{Quest|Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm}}.

==Overview==
Entered during {{Quest|Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm}}, the Major Forbidden Archive is the ''former'' Major Forbidden Archive that belonged to the [[Order of the Deep]] before the [[Dark Tide]] of [[Nimbus Sanctum]] swallowed it whole. The Major Forbidden Archive is where the Order stored the books, tales, and ideologies that were deemed dangerous.<ref name="QUEST">{{Quest|Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm}}
:'''Lenore:''' It's called the Minor Forbidden Archive. We have two: one big, one small. The Major Forbidden Archive is where we store all the really dangerous books, tales, and ideologies. Only the most devout servants of the Sentinel are permitted to serve there!
:[...]
:'''Lenore:''' This is the site of the Order of the Deep's Major Forbidden Archive—well, the former site.
:'''Lenore:''' After the Dark Tide, it was buried beneath Nimbus Sanctum along with all of its secrets.</ref>

Only the most devout servants of the [[Sentinel]], [[Imperator]], were permitted to serve the Major Forbidden Archive.<ref name="QUEST" />
